posts.text:
Kindness is contagious.
Leadership starts with example.

Video

Donald Trump’s immigration policies are cruel and assault the decency of our nation.

Video

Trump continues to overstep his authority, violate the constitution, and act more like a weak dictator than a strong president.

Video

Trump is making us less safe. He is making America more dangerous.

Video

Trump and his family are profiting off of war while American families pay the price.

op: nathancjun via IG

Video

Today, make sure to choose kindness. 

Together we can build a more loving world, one small act at a time.

Video

Don’t forget:
Trump’s ongoing chaotic tariffs continue to drive up costs for Americans and hurt our overall economy.

Video

Americans are already in an affordability crisis — and now gas prices are surging. Amazon is even adding fuel surcharges that will hit working families even harder.

This chaos, caused by the Trump administration’s reckless foreign policy, is unacceptable.

Video

Donald Trump continues to exhibit such weakness and is failing as commander and chief.

Thanks for sharing your perspective @JasonKander

Video

Donald Trump is an international embarrassment.

op: @harryjsisson

Video

Today, be brave.
Encourage someone else’s courage.
Lead by example.
Inspire someone to stand strong through it all.

Video

So many crises in the world and at home. And yet, beauty in art and nature remain vital to sustain, encourage, and inspire us. 

Newark’s Cherry Blossoms are in peak bloom. For me they are a good reminder, after a long dark and dangerous winter, spring will come. 

As the great promise from Psalm 30:5 tells us, 

“Weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning!”

op: adventuressashley via IG

Video

We need more American leaders to speak with this moral clarity, not violent and dangerous threats.

Video

Trump’s escalation in Iran is reckless. It is unconstitutional. It is dangerous with consequences both vast and globally destabilizing.

Right now, the world is holding its breath - watching, waiting, with many fearing what comes next.

Moments like this are why the Senate exists.
Not to sit silent. Not to stand down. But to check the abuses of an unrestrained executive.

We cannot abdicate that duty.

The Senate Majority Leader must choose country over party, summon the Senate back into session

This language isn't of strength it is weakness. 

Trump's crass and cruel speech diminish American greatness. 

Trump must be held accountable. 

Congressional Republicans must join us in putting this administration in check.

Video

It is a high bar for me to post anything positive about old PAC-10 rivals, but loved this!

Here is to seeing the dignity, value, worth, and even divinity in all.

Video

Encourage someone.
Cheer for another.
Celebrate the effort - 
Strides amidst strife; 
Progress and perseverance despite the odds of obstacles. 

We are all journeying toward something - all of us fighting, striving, trying.

And sometimes the greatest gift
is not the finish line…
it’s the voices calling your name along the way.

Lift someone and you rise too.

Video

Donald Trump is not the cause of everything that ails us, we must work together if we want to rise together.

Thanks for having me @profgalloway.

Video
